provenance.usage_policy: known completed logical calls; unresolved provider attempt reservations remain in the cumulative gateway ledger
provenance.sampling_policy: identical prompts with provider defaults, no assumed diversity

dataset.name: Texa Research Benchmark v3 candidate
dataset.split_policy: 300 answerable singles: 100 dev, 200 test. Test strata are 40 basic, 100 compositional, 60 semantic; dev 20/50/30. Each stratum is evenly allocated across Cosmetics Shop and Olist. Query families are labeled by phenomenon, not split prefix; template overlap is intentional and the split is not claimed to be family-disjoint. The three fixture worlds expose controlled grain/coverage changes, and every gold result is authored for each world.

source_capability_notes.cosmetics_shop: challenge-only synthetic events include sessions, views, device and campaign scalar paths.
source_capability_notes.olist_marketplace: challenge-only order item/payment/approval events; no synthetic sessions or viewers. Nested device/campaign fields are declared fixture extensions, not claims about the production source.

dataset.metric_semantics: Olist users are distinct customers observed in order-lifecycle events, not all website visitors. Olist buyer_conversion_rate is buyers divided by observed event-customers; it must not be described as visitor-to-buyer conversion. Purchase revenue is item-line revenue, excluding payment_made event values.
dataset.provenance: Fixture records reused from challenge_v1; this generator independently authors new query specs/SQL and computes expected results in Python for every controlled world. No Texa compiler or LLM generates the gold.
dataset.limitations: Synthetic controlled worlds do not estimate accuracy on live Cosmetics Shop or Olist data. Test labels are visible to the author and the candidate must be externally reviewed and sealed before confirmatory claims.

WITH olist AS (
    SELECT source_id
    FROM analytics.source_registry
    WHERE label ILIKE '%olist%'
), observed AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ea.user_id
    FROM analytics.event_activity ea
    JOIN olist o USING (source_id)
    WHERE ea.event_date BETWEEN DATE '2018-01-23' AND DATE '2018-01-29'
), buyers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ea.user_id
    FROM analytics.event_activity ea
    JOIN olist o USING (source_id)
    WHERE ea.event_date BETWEEN DATE '2018-01-23' AND DATE '2018-01-29'
      AND ea.event_name = 'purchase'
)
SELECT COUNT(b.user_id)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(o.user_id), 0) AS buyer_rate
FROM observed o
LEFT JOIN buyers b USING (user_id);

WITH observed_users AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.user_id) AS user_count
    FROM analytics.event_activity e
    JOIN analytics.source_registry s ON s.source_id = e.source_id
    WHERE s.label ILIKE '%Olist%'
      AND e.event_date BETWEEN DATE '2018-01-23' AND DATE '2018-01-29'
), category_buyers AS (
    SELECT
        e.item_category,
        COUNT(DISTINCT e.user_id) AS buyer_count
    FROM analytics.event_activity e
    JOIN analytics.source_registry s ON s.source_id = e.source_id
    WHERE s.label ILIKE '%Olist%'
      AND e.event_date BETWEEN DATE '2018-01-23' AND DATE '2018-01-29'
      AND e.event_name = 'purchase'
    GROUP BY e.item_category
)
SELECT
    cb.item_category,
    cb.buyer_count::NUMERIC / NULLIF(ou.user_count, 0) AS buyer_rate
FROM category_buyers cb
CROSS JOIN observed_users ou
ORDER BY cb.item_category

SELECT ea.item_category, COUNT(DISTINCT ea.user_id) AS unique_users
FROM analytics.event_activity AS ea
JOIN analytics.source_registry AS sr ON sr.source_id = ea.source_id
WHERE sr.label ILIKE '%Olist%'
  AND ea.event_date BETWEEN DATE '2018-01-27' AND DATE '2018-02-01'
GROUP BY ea.item_category
ORDER BY ea.item_category;

SELECT SUM(e.revenue) AS revenue
FROM analytics.event_activity AS e
JOIN analytics.source_registry AS s ON s.source_id = e.source_id
WHERE s.label = 'Olist'
  AND e.event_date BETWEEN DATE '2018-01-07' AND DATE '2018-01-12';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FILTER (WHERE event_name = 'purchase')::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT user_id), 0) AS buyer_to_observed_user_ratio
FROM analytics.event_activity
WHERE source_id IN (SELECT source_id FROM analytics.source_registry WHERE label ILIKE '%Olist%')
  AND event_date BETWEEN DATE '2018-01-21' AND DATE '2018-01-27'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.user_id) AS unique_users
FROM analytics.event_activity AS e
JOIN analytics.source_registry AS s ON s.source_id = e.source_id
WHERE s.label = 'Olist'
  AND e.event_date BETWEEN DATE '2018-01-27' AND DATE '2018-02-01';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS purchase_count
FROM analytics.event_activity AS ea
JOIN analytics.source_registry AS sr ON sr.source_id = ea.source_id
WHERE sr.label ILIKE '%Olist%'
  AND ea.event_date BETWEEN DATE '2018-01-07' AND DATE '2018-01-12'
  AND LOWER(ea.event_name) = 'purchase';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS unique_buyers
FROM analytics.event_activity
WHERE source_id = (SELECT source_id FROM analytics.source_registry WHERE label ILIKE '%Olist%' LIMIT 1)
  AND event_date BETWEEN DATE '2018-02-02' AND DATE '2018-02-06'
  AND event_name IN ('purchase', 'purchase_completed');
